title: Perceived consideration for users and value
summary: This topic centers on complaints about poor consideration for users, a suspected defect, and unclear value around EV pricing, with one contradictory fragment limiting coherence.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the car as poorly considered for users and mention what appears to be a clear defect, while one selected example conflicts with its assigned sentiment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention no discount for choosing the electric version and a broad feeling that the car lacks consideration for users, without enough context to fix sentiment confidently.

limitations: The selected fragments mix at least two subjects: user-centered design complaints and EV discount/value comments.
One negative-assigned fragment says 'zero problems,' which conflicts with the assigned sentiment and makes interpretation less reliable.
The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient to draw broader conclusions beyond these fragments.
